item.title: Street Fighter review – nostalgia only goes so far in junky fighting game movie
item.description: There are brief, simple pleasures in the inevitable new big screen take on the classic game but like the recent Mortal Kombat movies, it’s a largely incoherent mess We just had Resident Evil , Zach Cregger’s giddy, nasty, devilishly fun spin on Capcom’s popular zombie franchise. It gave us renewed hope (after Sonic the Hedgehog, The Last of Us and Fallout) that video game adaptations could be good, actually. But now here comes Street Fighter, a garish and incoherent mess that amuses in fits and starts but barely improves on the Mortal Kombat movies before it, crushing those hopes in its… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

What an odd confection Martin Scorsese compared them to theme parks. Nicolas Cage likened them to WWE. The products of the Marvel Cinematic Universe – 38 films, 18 television shows and counting – are not generally well regarded as works of art. item.title: ‘He’s terrified, panicked, can’t sleep’: the tragic, lonely death of Beatles manager Brian Epstein
item.description: Spandau Ballet’s Gary Kemp paid £10k at auction for Epstein’s address book. He then used it to co-author a thrilling account of the swinging 60s – and an intimate portrait of a tormented man whose life was unravelling The email from Sotheby’s might easily have gone unread. Despite his deep appreciation for the musical heroes who came before him, Gary Kemp is not a collector of rock memorabilia. But there, among the auction lots, was something that caught his eye: a 160x100mm black Twinlock binder that once belonged to the Beatles’ manager, Brian Epstein. item.title: ¿Quién era RJ Mitte?: el actor de 'Breaking Bad' que se propuso visibilizar la discapacidad
item.description: Durante cinco años fue Walter White Jr, el hijo con discapacidad de un profesor de química devenido en capo de la droga en la serie de culto ‘Breaking Bad’. Pero a lo largo de más de 20 años de carrera fue mucho más de eso: RJ Mitte fue él mismo una plataforma para proyectar a otros artistas con diversas formas de compromiso funcional. El actor, que puso fin a su vida el 12 de octubre a los 34 años, hizo visibles a intérpretes que de otra forma jamás habrían tenido una oportunidad en el mundo del espectáculo. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
